description.p: ChipCutter is an offline desktop Computer-Aided Manufacturing (CAM) application and headless CLI written in Rust that converts 3D STEP B-Rep models, triangle meshes (STL, OBJ, 3MF), 2D DXF/SVG vector drawings, and built-in parametric 2D sketches into verified CNC milling, routing, V-carving, and 4th-axis rotary G-code.

ul.li: Exact f64 B-Rep, mesh, and 2D vector toolpath generation with true circular arc preservation
2.5D Facing, 2D Contour with tabs, 2D Pocket, Adaptive roughing, Rest Machining, Drilling, Helical Bore, Chamfer, Trace, and V-Carving
3-axis surface milling (Waterline, Parallel, Scallop, Pencil) and 4th-axis indexed/wrapped/simultaneous rotary milling
Interactive 3D stock-removal simulation with rapid-into-stock and gouge verification
Configurable GRBL, grblHAL ATC, and LinuxCNC G-code post-processors plus headless CLI batch builds

screenshot.caption: ChipCutter 3D CAM workspace with toolpath preview and operation inspector
Interactive stock-removal simulation with animated cutter and holder
Adaptive clearing and rest machining toolpaths

description.p: Phase 24 release (UI Completeness & Inspector Parity): exposed plunge/ramp/lead feedrate & stepdown overrides in Operation Tool settings, preset material/coolant/feed controls and Delete Preset, Tool spindle direction/coolant/vendor/SKU metadata and Duplicate/Delete Tool, and refactored the Tool Library into aligned two-column collapsible property cards; exposed independent Lead-Out and Pre-Drilled entry controls in Linking, all 6 missing Drill/Bore fields (G82 dwell, G73 chip-break retract, peck decay, min peck, bore pitch & finish stepover), Contour2D finish feed, Adaptive2D/3D trochoid/feed/flat controls, and V-Carve clearing preset selection; added custom .post.toml selection in Setup Inspector, multi-body Target Bodies selection, WCS XY-plane X-edge picking & edge-endpoint switching, editable Relative Box rounding increments, SetupClearance retract reference, fixture color overrides, Workholding Wizard completeness (custom counterbore depth, grip band offset, pin protrusion, tool/WCS overrides), and Machine Manager shank/junction/power/description editing; added editable Error Heatmap max scale, SimVerificationConfig tolerances, Simulate All Setups, Export Metrology JSON, Export All Setups batch G-code export, read-only/clone-to-custom Post Profile Inspector, Edit → Project Properties and Edit → Manage Tools menus, Application Settings title & zero-creep sizing fix, vector import arc-fit tolerance, post-import model role/unit controls, and multi-setup Sketch reassignment; and updated ARCHITECTURE.md plus synchronized all 12 living specifications (00–11) with the codebase.

Phase 23 release: added explicit Model Bounds (MachiningBoundaryMode::ModelBoundingBox) with independent signed -X/+X/-Y/+Y per-side offsets and collapsed-bounds guarding across all 8 boundary-aware strategies; auto-expanding 2D Sketch Layers & Quick Select with per-entity quick-add and empty-state + New Sketch action; automatic Indexed 3+1 4th-axis viewport rotation (rotating the 3D CAD model, raw box/cylinder stock wireframes, picking rays, Z-height planes, and live Geometry boundary previews upright under +Z); Fixed-Size Box Stock XY Alignment and Z Alignment dropdown controls in Setup Stock Offsets (auto-defaulting rotary setups to Centered in Z); first-class per-operation and project-wide reusable Shared Avoid / Keep-Out Regions (3D faces, 2D sketch loops, and Z-overlapping Setup fixtures with radial/axial clearance and tiered shank/holder inflation) subtracted cleanly across all 3D, 2.5D, and 4th-axis rotary strategies with interactive Geometry tab controls, CAM Browser shared region management, and high-contrast coral/red 3D viewport overlays; and two new built-in Sample Gallery projects (keepout-clamps and indexed-model-bounds, 26 total).

Bug-fix & usability release: added a "Fill through-holes" option (silhouette_fill_holes, default enabled) to Model Silhouette machining boundaries across all 3-axis, Undercut3D, Deburr3D, and Facing operations plus live 3D viewport boundary previews so interior through-holes do not leave uncut stock pillars; and fixed a Windows CI timeout in the m73_indexed_carryover integration test by restoring ToolOutsideBoundary containment and widening the async wave deadline.

Phase 22 release: unified cutting-area and machining-boundary controls across 2.5D, 3-axis, undercut/deburr, and 4th-axis rotary operations inside the Operation Inspector Geometry tab with live 3D viewport boundary and rotary sector overlays; introduced shared MachiningBoundaryConfig with true projected 2D Model Silhouette polygons, circular Z-cylinder stock bounds, Adaptive3D StockBox containment/offset fixes, and Undercut3D/Deburr3D XY boundary support; introduced shared RotaryAxialBoundaryConfig (-U/+U StockBounds, ModelBounds, SelectedGeometry, ExplicitRange, axial ToolContainmentMode, signed overrun margins with mandatory chuck keep-out, outer radial roughing ceiling via Top Height, and WrapCylinder/Indexed3Plus1 chuck protection); upgraded 2.5D Facing to exact polygon and raised-island clipping, added Pocket2D/Adaptive2D boss-clearing (ClearOutsideSelectedToStock) and open-outer-boundary support plus Contour2D stock clipping and open-chain extension; added wall-clock execution time logging for toolpath generation and stock simulation; and refreshed all specifications, tutorials, sample gallery pages, and screenshots for Phases 21–22.

Bug-fix release: pooled headless GLES GPU contexts to prevent wgpu-hal adapter lock timeouts (#32); split and flattened GPU Tri-Dexel WGSL shaders for Windows FXC compatibility (#33); and pinned ZIP system metadata for cross-platform 3MF and .chipz archive determinism (#34).

Phase 21 release: added a unified Settings modal (Ctrl+,) consolidating Display/Theme, Navigation/Input, Simulation (engine, detail level, and mesh skinning), and Workspace/Defaults while decluttering infrequent controls from the simulation timeline and viewport chrome; added clear Active Setup highlighting and a separator-grouped top action bar for creating operations without duplicating buttons on every setup card; streamlined tool management to a single Tools button, upgraded the Project Tools browser card with direct add, usage badges, guarded delete, and Remove Unused pruning, improved Operation tool selection with grouped/searchable pickers, and added an interactive Switch Machine tool-replacement dialog; and added live-toggleable CPU and WGSL GPU simulation mesh skinning powered by 3D Surface Nets crossing-point centroids, crease-preserving corner normals, and smooth uncut stock blending across Tri-Dexel, Heightfield, and Cylindrical stocks.

UI polish release: consolidated background toolpath generation and stock simulation progress into a single compact progress bar beside the top-toolbar Generate/Simulate/Post controls, removed redundant simulation start controls and duplicate percentage readouts from the Simulation Timeline panel, added live JobDispatcher batch progress tracking, and enabled Esc cancellation for in-flight simulations (#30).

Phase 20 release: hardened all 3-axis, 2.5D, indexed 3+1, workholding, and 4th-axis rotary toolpathing kernels for overhanging and continuously twisting helical lofts—adding multi-tier shank and collet/holder target-part clearance across drop_cutter_z and PushCutterField with reach-limit diagnostics; adding automatic 2.5D overhang-plunge warnings and an opt-in Avoid Model Overhangs mode across Pocket2D, Contour2D, DrillBore, Facing, and ChamferTrace; scoping 2D rest machining by rotary index angle and adding in-setup cross-angle volumetric Tri-Dexel stock carryover plus continuous swept Z-slab excess masks; suppressing false overhang-shadow creases and rest bands in Pencil3D/build_3d_rest_mask, splitting Parallel3D/Scallop3D chains safely at overhang cliffs, and extracting continuous swept clamping-band silhouettes for Auto Soft-Jaws; adding verified partial-sector ZigZag rotary links, overhang-aware multi-offset SurfaceNormalAutoTilt flank probing, and axial-undercut reach warnings; and adding OS clipboard support with selectable/copyable Activity Logs (#26), Flatpak host filesystem access and hardened missing-model handling (#27), live simulation percent-complete progress telemetry (#28), and Surface Nets GPU Tri-Dexel curved surface rendering with batched GPU sweeps (#29).

Bug-fix release: refactored chip-cli clap subcommand parsing into boxed per-subcommand Args structs to eliminate Windows debug main-thread stack overflows under the 1 MiB default stack limit, and added a 768 KiB stack-headroom regression test (#25).

Bug-fix release: enabled full 3D volumetric Tri-Dexel simulation on 4th-axis rotary setups across both CPU and WGSL GPU backends (supporting deep below-centerline indexed 3+1 cuts, interior off-centerline slots, overhanging helical flutes, live rotary stock animation, and rotary chuck keep-out collision checks), and expanded polar CylindricalStock angular search bounds when cutting below the rotary centerline (#24).

Bug-fix release: replaced tip-band-only push-cutter slicing in 3D Adaptive and 3D Waterline with a precomputed analytical drop-cutter avoidance field (PushCutterField) and Marching Squares contour extraction so descending Z levels remain strictly monotonic and preserve overhanging helical lofts, flanges, and undercuts without vertical shank gouges or rapid retract collisions (#23); and added panic-safe power-of-two coordinate scaling with cleaned multi-scale fallback for complex 2D boolean operations in chip-geom2d.

Phase 19 release: achieved 100% tutorial, starter-asset, and Sample Projects Gallery coverage across all shipped ChipCutter capabilities—adding 6 new crash-free built-in samples (feed-opt-pocket, flip-jig-softjaws, curved-deburr-3d, dovetail-rail-keyway, svg-badge, and mesh-3mf-bracket) plus 6 minimal tutorial starter assets; publishing illustrated Tutorials 20 (GPU-Accelerated Simulation, Benchmarking, and Feedrate Optimization), 21 (3D Edge Deburring and Non-Planar Chamfering), and 22 (Undercut Keyway, T-Slot, Dovetail, and Lollipop Milling) with verified headless Vulkan screenshots; completing all 24 dedicated Sample Projects Gallery pages and GitHub Pages/README sync enforced by automated docs and Markdown link parity tests; and making WGSL shader return paths FXC-safe for Windows D3DCompile (#22).

Phase 18 release: added LollipopEndmill, SlotMill (Keyway/T-Slot), and DovetailCutter geometries with non-monotonic AnalyticCutterEnvelope undercut math, CPU and WGSL GPU Tri-Dexel undercut sweeping and relieved-neck collision verification, 3D revolved cutter meshes for all 10 cutter types, and Tool Library 2D schematics; added 3D Edge Deburring and Non-Planar Chamfering (Deburr3D) with B-Rep bisector contact, inside-corner wall collision trimming, and Lollipop underside back-chamfering; added Slot/Keyway/T-Slot (SlotUndercut), Internal/External Dovetail (Dovetail), and Lollipop 3D Overhang Undercut (Undercut3D) strategies with strict horizontal entry/exit safety guards and Inspector cards; added the undercut-deburr built-in sample and auto-Tri-Dexel CLI build verification for undercut jobs; fixed truncated flat surfaces in Ultra GPU Tri-Dexel rendering via compact quad emission (#20); and fixed periodic NURBS/B-spline STEP sweep tessellation and bounded edge trimming (#21).

Phase 17 release: added first-class 3D shop-floor workholding fixtures (parametric Vise Jaws with step shelves and parallels, Toe/Strap Clamps with stud towers, Spoilboards with overcut tolerance, Box/Cylinder Keep-Outs, and imported STEP/STL/OBJ/3MF fixture models via ModelRole::Fixture) with interactive 3D viewport placement, translucent rendering, and the Setup [Fixtures] Inspector tab; added automatic full-assembly fixture-aware safe-rapid lifting and export-blocking Rule 6 FixtureCollision verification across CPU and GPU backends; added multi-setup volumetric Tri-Dexel stock carryover (G54 to G55) with rest-aware Op-2 air-cut skipping and cumulative error-volume metrology (chipcutter simulate --all-setups); added Two-Sided Flip-Jig Dowel-Pin and Auto Soft-Jaw Generator wizards (CNC setup and watertight 3D-printable STL export), built-in two-sided-vise sample, and illustrated Tutorial 19; added the Makera Essential Milling Bit Set (Extended) to Makera built-in machines; fixed 4-axis rotary strategies to cut hollow stock centers cleanly to r = 0; and updated url to 2.5.9 (RUSTSEC-2026-0592).

Phase 16 release: upgraded 4th-axis rotary toolpaths with exact direct BVH drop-cutter evaluation, adaptive midpoint chord refinement, slope-compensated cusp stepover, and 3x finer cylindrical pose subdivision; eliminated 3-axis surface finishing chord gouges with zero-gouge chord refinement, higher-resolution smoothed Scallop3D, local contour-offset Waterline3D stepdowns, and sub-cell parabolic Pencil3D ridge centering; added engagement-aware feedrate optimization (internal-arc centerline scaling, sharp-corner lookahead deceleration, radial chip-thinning boost) with Inspector controls and timeline telemetry; fixed 2.5D circular-island rest cleanup and V-Carve Z-chord refinement; isolated background GPU simulation compute onto a dedicated headless wgpu device to prevent Surface::configure panics during window resizes; and updated tutorial commands for installed chip-gui and chipcutter binaries.

Phase 15 release: added an optional wgpu Compute simulation and direct rendering backend (gpu-compute feature with zero new external dependencies and transparent exact CPU fallback), tiled WGSL compute sweepers for 2.5D Heightfield, 4th-axis Cylindrical (up to 5.8x faster at Ultra), and flat fixed-K Tri-Dexel (with lossless hybrid CPU overflow for multi-form thread undercuts), GPU BVH target rasterization and parallel-reduction stock-vs-target error metrics, zero-readback direct GPU stock rendering with instant Error Heatmap tolerance updates, VRAM-bounded GPU checkpoints, GUI backend selector and adapter status badge, and CLI --backend/--benchmark reporting.
Bug-fix release: fixed 2.5D heightfield simulation swept-interval intersection along sloped linear moves for flat endmills, eliminating false rapid/ramp stock removal artifacts on ramped entries.

Phase 14 architecture refactoring release: extracted dedicated pure-kernel internal crates (chip-bvh flat SAH BVH, chip-geom2d exact 2D polygon/Voronoi/arc kernel, and chip-stock volumetric stock engines), unified Heightfield/Tri-Dexel/Cylindrical simulation behind SimStockBackend with an axis-generic flat fixed-K Tri-Dexel span pool and zero-copy GPU vertex/buffer layouts, fixed multi-body STL/OBJ/3MF target_bodies filtering in Tri-Dexel verification, moved interactive simulation stock remeshing off the UI thread with rapid-scrub coalescing, and decomposed oversized modules across the workspace.

Phase 13 release: added four new built-in CNC machine profiles (Makera Carvera, Makera Carvera Z1, Millennium Machines Milo v2.0, and Voron Cascade) and full end-to-end Helical Thread Milling (single-point and multi-form cutters, ISO Metric and Unified UNC/UNF thread tables, internal holes and external bosses, radial tangent arc-in/out, Tri-Dexel 3D helical undercut simulation, Tool Library & Passes Inspector UI, built-in thread-mill sample, and illustrated Tutorial 18).

Bug-fix release: fixed a polyline offset panic on Relief Wave evolute cusps, enabled stock-vs-target error-volume and RMS metrics for 4th-axis cylindrical simulations, and added signed Error Heatmap rendering on 4th-axis cylindrical stock.

GUI polish and illustrated documentation release: unified collapsible card styling across the CAM Browser and right-side Inspectors, strict two-column Inspector layouts, consistent eyeball (visibility) vs. checkbox (active/inactive) semantics, universal hover tooltips across all controls, faster Error Heatmap meshing and playback deferral with clear toggle controls, an unsaved-changes confirmation dialog on window close, and an illustrated Sample Projects Gallery with per-operation completion screenshots.

Added selectable Tri-Dexel 3D volumetric CAM simulation alongside fast 2.5D heightmap simulation, quantitative stock-vs-target error-volume and RMS/MAE/P95/P99 surface deviation metrics, signed deviation Error Heatmap visualization, CLI --engine/--tolerance JSON benchmarking, and illustrated Tutorial 17.
Bug-fix release: reset all active project, model, simulation, G-code preview, and cached geometry state cleanly when opening or switching projects.

Added non-destructive per-model orientation, lay-flat, scaling, target-size fitting, and positioning for STEP solids and STL/OBJ/3MF meshes (GUI Model Transform Inspector, Mesh Import orientation preview, CLI transform-model, and associative Ctrl+R reload preservation), Setup WCS fine Z-axis clocking, and illustrated Tutorial 16.

Security hardening release: read-only built-in post-processors, sanitized G-code output paths and metadata, cumulative zip-bomb and parser complexity caps, private temporary extraction directories, and SHA-pinned release workflows.

Added Machine Definitions and per-machine tool libraries (Generic, Millennium Machines Milo v1.5 LDO Kit, Makera Carvera Air), upgrade-safe cloning and .machine.toml export/import, machine envelope/RPM diagnostics, and the Help -> About dialog.
Initial release of ChipCutter with 2.5D milling, 3-axis mesh finishing, 4th-axis rotary toolpaths, stock-removal simulation, and verified GRBL/LinuxCNC G-code post-processing.
